name: Moon Priestess Amara
summary: West of Dolanaar, Moon Priestess Amara watches Teldrassil’s road to Darnassus. Two huntresses guard her as she keeps watch over the woodland paths.

sections.title: Guardian of the Boughways
sections.body: Moon Priestess Amara watches the road west of Dolanaar with two huntress companions, Nhemai and Yaeliura. As a priestess of the Sisterhood of Elune, she brings spiritual guidance to her post, while her watch helps keep Teldrassil’s roads secure. Travelers heading west can seek her direction toward Darnassus. Those burdened in spirit can also seek a path of redemption from her.

faq.answer: Moon Priestess Amara, also known as Amara Nightwalker, is a priestess of the Sisterhood of Elune. She watches the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus in Teldrassil, tending to travelers’ safety and spiritual well-being.

faq.q: Where can I find Moon Priestess Amara?
faq.answer: You can find her along the paved road just west of Dolanaar in Teldrassil, with two sentinel huntresses at her side.

faq.q: Who are the huntresses standing with her?
faq.answer: Huntress Nhemai and Huntress Yaeliura accompany and guard Amara. The two night elf sentinels help protect the road from beasts and hostile corruption.

angles.text: As a priest of the Sisterhood of Elune, you share Priestess Amara’s devotion to the Moon Goddess. She guides young acolytes setting out from Shadowglen.
As a night elf, you meet Amara on your journey west from Dolanaar. Her guidance and tasks lead toward Darnassus.
